note: nachal mitsrayim is the seasonal Wadi el-Arish, not the Nile (cf. v. 4; 2 Kgs 24:7).

kjv: thou hast given me a south land
mine: you have given me the land of the Negev
note: 'erets hannegev is the named dry region south of Judah. "South land" obscures that Achsah is complaining it has no water.
